reads.title: The Gaza Plan: Delivered, Stalled, Reversed
reads.summary: A year after the Trump plan for Gaza, this report checks all 20 points: what got done, what stalled and why, and three possible paths to 2027. It's a think-tank view, so read it as one side's argument.

reads.title: A New Dawn For Mathematical Progress
reads.summary: As AI systems start solving famous maths problems, what counts as progress in mathematics? A historical essay that argues humans keep a real role. Read it as one writer's argument.

reads.title: Navigating a Shock-Prone World: Lessons from Cost-of-Living Crises
reads.summary: An IMF study of price shocks in 85 economies since 2005: why poorer households are hit hardest and which kinds of help work. Skim the maths; read it as the IMF's market-minded view.

reads.title: UNEP: Opportunity has 'been lost' to meet 1.5C warming limit without 'overshoot'
reads.summary: A chart-rich walk through the UN's latest emissions gap report: why warming will pass 1.5C for a while, where current policies lead, and what cuts would change it. Good context for COP31.

reads.title: How to Increase America's AI Lead Over China
reads.summary: A US think tank's detailed estimate of China's AI computing power, how much depends on US chips, and its policy proposals. Read it as one side's argument.
